purpose: Test whether a stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 preserves Electricity/Traffic H96 accuracy while reducing the v3 prediction cost.
research_question: Can a full-coverage sparse patch layout retain competitive validation accuracy with AutoCon representation learning and reduce fixed-shape forward cost?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This screen evaluates a speed-oriented architecture tradeoff only. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, independent AutoCon causality, or end-to-end throughput.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and exact 30-job expansion
freeze sparse patch and baseline settings and seeds

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Sparse patch layout, candidate/baseline set, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds are fixed before launch; no held-out signal or post-hoc speed result may alter them.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only MambaTSv3AutoCon receives AutoCon lambda=.001; candidate uses patch_len=24 and patch_stride=24.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: External baselines receive no AutoCon, representation fusion, ACF memory, or candidate-only setting.

phases.name: sparse_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-coordinate DLinear, PatchTST, iTransformer, and plain Mamba-1 baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report paired validation deltas and separately attested fixed-shape resources; do not infer speed from training wall time.

stopping_rules: Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
Do not promote the sparse candidate if it is more than 2% worse than the strongest external baseline on either dataset.
Do not infer AutoCon causality from candidate-versus-baseline differences alone.
prelaunch_gates: freeze sparse patch and baseline settings and seeds
